name: Koga Tsuyoshi
source:
Basketball ace in the school that for some odd reason likes to pick fights with Ryou and Akira. Despises those that don’t take sports (life) seriously.

[From [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2010/06/10/riaimo-mini-review/]Tomato Conspiracy[/url]]

[spoiler]The real reason he is hostile toward Akira and Ryou is that he is actually a siscon and envious of Akira and Ryou to have a real imouto beside them. But he then falls in love with Ryou after he sees Ryou does a slamdunk.[/spoiler]
